400 Bad Request error when OCR input has an invalid image format

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\OcrRequest;
$request = \Liter\Llm\OcrRequest::from_json(json_encode(["document" => ["type" => "document_url", "url" => "invalid://url"], "model" => "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"]));
try {
    LiterLlm::ocr($request);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
```
